Centurion. Commander of a hundred men.
 

 
Italian band. Probably recruited in Italy.

entries.title: Acts 10:2
segments: A devout man. A sincere believer in God, observing as far as possible the Jewish religious customs, such as the prayer hours and almsgiving, but, owing to lack of circumcision, not an accredited member of the Jewish religious community.

entries.title: Acts 10:3
segments: Ninth hour. Three o'clock in the afternoon.

entries.title: Acts 10:9
segments:
The housetop. The roofs of oriental houses are flat, and convenient for prayer and meditation.  They could be reached by an outside staircase.
 

 
Sixth hour. Noon.

entries.title: Acts 10:10
segments: A trance. A state in which the soul seems to have left the body, and during a temporary absence has visions of spiritual realities.
